label: 📭 Empty input / size 0
sawal: Agar input array/string empty [] ya "" ho to answer kya hona chahiye?
action: Check constraints me min size kya hai (sizeLo >= 1 ya 0?). Agar 0 possible hai to starting me base check lagao.
trap: Direct nums[0] access karna bina size check kiye (IndexOutOfBounds / NullPointer throw karega).

label: 1️⃣ Single element (n = 1)
sawal: Kya logic tab bhi kaam karega jab array me sirf 1 hi element ho?
action: Loop conditions (left < right ya i < n - 1) ko n=1 pe dry run karo.
trap: Loops jo kam se kam 2 elements expect karte hain (jaise pair comparisons) crash ya wrong answer de sakte hain.

label: 👯 Sab elements identical (All duplicates)
sawal: Agar input ke saare elements bilkul same hon (e.g. [2, 2, 2, 2]), to kya logic infinite loop me fasega?
action: Two pointers ya binary search me duplicate skipping logic (nums[i] == nums[i-1]) ko test karo.
trap: Pointers ka static reh jana (stuck in while loop) ya partition logic ka unbalanced split dena (QuickSelect worst case).

label: ➖ Negative numbers & Zero
sawal: Kya negative values sum ko ghatati hain? Kya zero se division ya multiplication me gadbad hogi?
action: Sliding window me sum badhne ki assumption mat lo (negatives me window contract hone par bhi sum badh sakta hai). Prefix Sum + Map socho.
trap: Sliding window ko negatives wale array pe laga dena (window condition monotonic nahi rehti).

label: 🔁 Duplicates allowed
sawal: Kya answer me distinct elements chahiye ya duplicates allow hain? Output me duplicates kaise handle karne hain?
action: HashSet use karo ya array ko sort karke adjacent identical elements ko `if (i > start && nums[i] == nums[i-1]) continue;` se skip karo.
trap: Subsets / Combinations me duplicate sets generate kar dena jo problem me strictly forbidden hote hain.

label: 📶 Already sorted / Reverse sorted
sawal: Agar array already ascending ya strictly descending order me ho, to kya algorithms (jaise QuickSort pivot) degenerate honge?
action: Extreme monotonicity pe check karo: left aur right pointers boundary paar to nahi kar rahe?
trap: Binary search me infinite loop jab mid pointer move nahi karta.

label: 💥 Integer overflow (> 2^31 - 1)
sawal: Kya sum, product ya mid calculation (low + high) 2 * 10^9 exceed kar sakta hai?
action: Sum ke liye 64-bit integer (`long` in Java/C++, `BigInt` in JS) use karo. Mid ke liye `lo + (hi - lo) / 2` likho.
trap: `(lo + hi) / 2` likhna jab lo aur hi dono ~10^9 hain (2 * 10^9 integer limit todkar negative number ban jayega).

label: 🚫 Index out of bounds (i ± 1, mid - 1)
sawal: Jab tum `nums[i + 1]` ya `nums[i - 1]` check karte ho, to kya i = 0 ya i = n - 1 pe bounds cross ho sakte hain?
action: Boundary guards lagao: `i > 0 && nums[i] == nums[i-1]` ya `i + 1 < n`.
trap: Guard condition ko baad me likhna, jaise `nums[i-1] == x && i > 0` (pehle access hoga phir check, jo crash karega).

label: ❓ No valid solution exists
sawal: Agar problem ka koi valid answer na mile, to return type kya honi chahiye? (-1, empty array [], null, false)?
action: Problem statement ki last line ('Return -1 if not found') padho aur default return statement sahi set karo.
trap: Function ke end me undefined ya unhandled path chhod dena.
